item.title: Construction to begin on Ocean Gate Plaza intersection improvements
item.description: Construction is set to begin at the end of month on intersection improvements at Ocean Gate Plaza and New Pointe Boulevard.

item.title: Laney High School names new head football coach
item.description: A former New Hanover defensive coordinator will be joining Laney High School as the head coach of their football team.

item.title: Governor Stein declares State of Emergency ahead of winter storm
item.description: On Wednesday, Governor Josh Stein declared a state of emergency as North Carolina prepares for impacts from a winter storm.

item.description: An update on a big win for the residents of Carolina Shores.

item.title: Crews respond to boat fire in Carolina Beach
item.description: Fire crews responded to a boat fire in Carolina Beach late Wednesday afternoon.

item.title: Residents happy after hearing decision over controversial dirt bike track in Pender County
item.description: At the Board of Adjustment meeting in Pender County, nearby residents of Salty Acres Park are happy after hearing the board's decision to see if the park is in violation of operating a commercial business in a residential zone.

item.title: New Hanover County opens new facility to aid prisoners in transitioning back into the community
item.description: New Hanover County hosted a ribbon-cutting ceremony today, Jan. 21, for a new facility intended to aid prisoners in their transition back into the community.

item.title: As Pender County continues to grow, the need for jobs does as well.
item.description: Since 2018, Pender County has seen its workforce grow more than 18 percent. As the county continues to see an uptick in population and economic growth, it's aiming to bring in more high-paying jobs.

item.title: A former flight attendant is accused of fooling airlines into giving him free flights. But how?
item.description: A former flight attendant accused of posing as a pilot and working airline employee fooled three U.S. carriers into giving him hundreds of free tickets over a span of four years, federal authorities say. But precisely how he is alleged to have done it — and why the airlines wouldn't have caught on sooner — has industry insiders scratching their heads.
